Subject: Re: Intro + demo — security items we flagged

Hi Marta 9thanks for the call earlier and for surfacing the audit needs. Quick write-up so were aligned and can action: 

1) Pain points you raised:
- Regulatory focus on auditable logs and deterministic retention (PCI overlap).
- Need evidence for internal auditors (SOC 2 Type II latest report, DPA, pen-test summary).
- Predictable behavior during peak payment windows and fallback controls.

2) Short-term goal:
- Run a 30-day POC with production-like traffic to validate throughput and audit-log collection/export.

3) Evidence & artifacts Redwood will provide:
- SOC 2 Type II (latest) or bridge letter if within 12 months.
- Pen-test executive summary (redacted findings + remediation status).
- Audit-log schema (CSV attached) and example retention policies for 1 year and 3 years.
- DPA template; happy to sign the copy you attached.

4) Action owners / dates:
- ClearStream (Marta): confirm whether a bridge letter is acceptable (target: 2026-07-22).
- Ben: deliver audit-log schema + evidence-request spreadsheet (attached) (today).
- Marcus (SE): short tech note on fallback behavior, KMS options, and encryption-at-rest/in-transit (2026-07-21).
- Neha (Security): full list of items we can share and recommended transfer mechanism (SFTP/DocuSign/Secure drive) (2026-07-20).

Attachments: Audit-Log-Schema.csv, evidence-request-template.xlsx

Can you confirm the preferred upload channel for sensitive artifacts (safely@clearstream.com was mentioned)? If the timeline looks right, well come prepared on the 07/22 follow-up to lock the evidence list.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0186
